IMMIGRATION PULSE — July 8, 2026
5 things that changed in U.S. immigration. Every figure is sourced and labelled.

1. 33,184 border encounters added in May [Reported]
   Monthly inflow up vs the prior month. FY total so far: 249,060.
   Source: CBP Nationwide Encounters — https://www.cbp.gov/newsroom/stats/nationwide-encounters

2. Texas layoffs down 12% month-over-month [Reported]
   1,160 employees across 9 WARN notices in June 2026, vs 1,322 in May 2026. Texas only.
   Source: Texas WARN Notices — https://data.texas.gov/d/8w53-c4f6

3. ICE removals running above the FY2024 pace [Projected]
   At the current pace, FY2026 would reach ~465.9K removals vs 271,484 in FY2024.
   Source: ICE Enforcement and Removal Statistics — https://www.ice.gov/statistics

4. H-1B employer data still lags ~21 months behind the real economy [Reported]
   The latest official USCIS employer release is FY2024 (latest release). Layoffs and the labor market move months before the visa data catches up.
   Source: USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub — https://www.uscis.gov/tools/reports-and-studies/h-1b-employer-data-hub

5. U.S. unemployment at 4.2% (June 2026) [Reported]
   The labor-market backdrop for the immigration debate — fetched live from BLS.
   Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — https://www.bls.gov/cps/

BY THE NUMBERS
- Border encounters · FY2026 YTD: 249.1K
- ICE removals · FY2026 YTD: 330K
- Texas layoffs · 2026 YTD: 12,234
- U.S. unemployment: 4.2%

Full Pulse: https://immigrationclock.com/pulse

# Immigration Pulse — July 8, 2026

**5 things that changed** in U.S. immigration. Every figure is sourced and labelled.

**1. 33,184 border encounters added in May** _(Reported)_
Monthly inflow up vs the prior month. FY total so far: 249,060.
[CBP Nationwide Encounters](https://www.cbp.gov/newsroom/stats/nationwide-encounters)

**2. Texas layoffs down 12% month-over-month** _(Reported)_
1,160 employees across 9 WARN notices in June 2026, vs 1,322 in May 2026. Texas only.
[Texas WARN Notices](https://data.texas.gov/d/8w53-c4f6)

**3. ICE removals running above the FY2024 pace** _(Projected)_
At the current pace, FY2026 would reach ~465.9K removals vs 271,484 in FY2024.
[ICE Enforcement and Removal Statistics](https://www.ice.gov/statistics)

**4. H-1B employer data still lags ~21 months behind the real economy** _(Reported)_
The latest official USCIS employer release is FY2024 (latest release). Layoffs and the labor market move months before the visa data catches up.
[USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub](https://www.uscis.gov/tools/reports-and-studies/h-1b-employer-data-hub)

**5. U.S. unemployment at 4.2% (June 2026)** _(Reported)_
The labor-market backdrop for the immigration debate — fetched live from BLS.
[U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics](https://www.bls.gov/cps/)

## By the numbers
- Border encounters · FY2026 YTD: **249.1K**
- ICE removals · FY2026 YTD: **330K**
- Texas layoffs · 2026 YTD: **12,234**
- U.S. unemployment: **4.2%**
